name: The Lucky Fool
pitch: You cannot hit anything, so you stand there apologising while a top-end elder trips over their own art four times, and then they get your bill.
channel: the enemy's own arts, redirected by a fortune roll

new.name: Slip of the Hand
new.effect: Every art that would hit, on either side, first rolls 0.05 + (other's fortune - caster's fortune) x 0.001. A slip resolves on its caster, through their own ward, at most 30 % of their maximum health. Closes your own hitting arts.
new.second_home: any jinx, any cursed ground, any NPC with bad luck about them

new.name: When the Worst Has Passed
new.effect: Each roll against you that fails adds its chance to a visible count. At 1.0 the next one lands and the count returns to 0.
new.second_home: any chance build: crit, status or escape

new.name: Someone Else's Problem
new.effect: On a knockout win, the loser pays your Years Owed.
new.second_home: any Slow Wound user, any debt

new.name: Dull Fortune
new.effect: +1 khi_van per point of comprehension under 50, to +40.
new.second_home: any thể tu who skipped the reading

new.name: A roll that remembers
